scope: Manual reviewed SSH access to a single explicitly named remote herdr session/pane; one full frame, no remote input

host.policy: DNS name or IP only, no whitespace/control characters or URL

expectedHostKey.policy: ssh-ed25519 and canonical base64 SSH public-key wire blob; parse type/length, compare before authentication; reject extra lines/options

privateKeyPem.policy: explicit in-memory experimental OpenSSH Ed25519 key only; no discovery, persistence, diagnostics, artifact or clipboard capture

socketPath.policy: absolute canonical remote path <configRoot>/herdr/sessions/<session>/herdr.sock; no control characters, dot/dotdot or empty interior segments; derive fixed XDG_CONFIG_HOME from this path

herdrPath.policy: absolute remote executable path; shell-quote as data, no arbitrary command

session.policy: explicit named session only; reserved default is unsupported in this step

reviewConfirmed.policy: explicit review of source, target and expected host key; never inferred from import/scan

commands.snapshot: one direct-streamlocal channel, one session.snapshot RPC, validate response id and result, then close
commands.observe: fixed /usr/bin/env with only shell-quoted XDG_CONFIG_HOME derived from canonical socketPath; shell-quoted herdrPath --session session terminal session observe resolvedTerminalId --cols 80 --rows 24; no SSH PTY/control/takeover/resize; close after validated full frame

lifecycle: Every attempt owns an internal generation; cancellation or target change invalidates it before transport cleanup.
Late frames and completions cannot replace newer UI state.
One-shot snapshot is labelled read-only and not realtime; refreshing is explicit.
No automatic retry, reconnect, credential fallback, trust acceptance or replay.
Authentication starts only after actual SSH host key comparison succeeds.
No remote write methods are exposed by this adapter, including from terminal callbacks.

cli.negativeEvidence: wrong-pin must reach the actual key callback, fail comparison and never start authentication; transport timeout/refusal does not pass this case
cli.secrets: config and keys live only in the self-created CI temporary fixture; outputs contain no config, credentials, raw server messages or raw stdout/stderr

binding.snapshot: exact selected paneId must exist and resolve to nonempty terminal_id matching ^term_[0-9a-f]+$
binding.observe: use that resolved terminal_id as CLI target, never reuse paneId as fallback; force the same derived config root and named session
binding.boundary: herdr 0.9.5 snapshot/frame do not echo session identity; binding relies on pinned server path and terminal resolver semantics, not a frame identity field
